## Routes and failures

Route panels follow the Endpoint filter. Unhandled requests, routing failures, rejected connections, and exceptions are global within the selected instances.

spec.description: Top matched route templates for the selected endpoints, instances, and time range.
spec.title: Top routes by requests — selected range

spec.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http\.route) (increase({__name__="http.server.request.duration_bucket", service\.name="WordoGuessr.WebAPI", service\.instance\.id=~"${instance:regex}", http\.route=~"${endpoint:regex}"}[$__range]))))

spec.description: Top matched route templates by p95 latency, with request count showing the sample size for the selected range.
spec.title: Slowest routes by p95 — selected range

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by (http\.route, http\.response\.status_code) (increase({__name__="http.server.request.duration_count", service\.name="WordoGuessr.WebAPI", service\.instance\.id=~"${instance:regex}", http\.route=~"${endpoint:regex}", http\.response\.status_code=~"[45].."}[$__range]))) > 0
